item.title: दह्
item.description: दहँ = द ह चंद्र बिंदी (Roll, Give, Throw, infuse, share) (dry grass, leaves, horripilation, exists) inside, surface, outside, pull, push Hence throw dry grass inside = burn धातु अर्थ at भस्मीकरण = भस्म करण burn.
